name: Usotsuki wa Tenshi no Hajimari
original_name: ウソツキは天使のはじまり
source:
Main character miraculously survives in several certain death situations. He starts to see invisible to other people angel and demon fight each other at such times. Both angel and demon become weakened due to human awareness about them, so they decide to live together with protagonist till their powers restore.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在几次必死无疑的险境中奇迹生还。每逢此时，他都会看见常人无法察觉的天使与恶魔互相争斗。由于人类开始意识到他们的存在，天使与恶魔的力量都随之衰弱，于是他们决定与主人公共同生活，直到力量恢复。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
